h:
此工作流程接收包含图像列表的文本文件，使用 WD 1.4 标记将图像的标记列表输出到与图像文件命名相同但扩展名为 .txt 的文件中。请阅读以下内容：

#1：如果有任何节点是红色的，请使用 ComfyUI Manager 下载它们。此工作流程使用 ComfyMath、WAS Node Suite、ComfyUI_lb_CustomNodes、pythongosssss/ComfyUI-Custom-Scripts、pythongosssss/ComfyUI WD 1.4 Tagger、tinyterraNodes 和 Quality of life Suite V2。

#2：在“Text Load Line From File”节点中填写文本文件的完整路径。剩下的就别管了。

#3：增量只能发生在 0-2048 的基元上。当达到这个值时，任何批处理都会重复创建 2048 个标记文件（或者 IntBinaryOperation“a”字段中的任何值 + 2048）。

#4：列表中的所有文件名和所有路径必须具有相同的长度，否则您将无法获得匹配的文件名。您将需要调整两个文本字符串截断字段中的 truncate_to 值以提供正确的文件名结果。第一个剥离前端（路径），第二个剥离末端（延伸）。 （我知道它的读法相反，但相信我，这就是它的工作原理......我不知道，我没有写节点。）

#5：调整 3x TXT Loader MultiConcat 节点中的第一个文本字段以包含要保存 .txt 文件的路径。

#6：准备好后，单击“额外选项”，在“批次计数”中输入 1-2048 之间的值，然后单击“队列提示”。坐下来看着它过去。 （我确实建议在运行大批量之前先进行少量测试，以确保一切设置正常。）

感谢您查看工作流程，希望它对您有用。 -灵魂

o.en:
This workflow takes in a text file containing a list of images, uses WD 1.4 tagging to output a list of tags for the image into a file named the same as the image file, but with a .txt extension. Please read below:

#1: If any nodes are red, use ComfyUI Manager to download them. This workflow uses ComfyMath, WAS Node Suite, ComfyUI_lb_CustomNodes, pythongosssss/ComfyUI-Custom-Scripts, pythongosssss/ComfyUI WD 1.4 Tagger, tinyterraNodes, & Quality of life Suite V2.

#2: Fill in the full path to your text file in the Text Load Line From File node. Leave the rest alone.

#3: Incrementing can only occur on the Primitive from 0-2048. When you reach that, any batching will just repeat the tag file creation for 2048 (or whatever value you have in the IntBinaryOperation "a" field + 2048).

#4: All file names in the list and all paths must be the same length or else you will not get matching file names. You will need to adjust the truncate_to values in the two Text String Truncate fields to provide the correct file name result. The first one strips the front off (the path) and the second strips the end off (the extension). (I know it reads the other way around, but trust me, that's how it works...I dunno, I didn't write the nodes.)

#5: Adjust the first text field in the 3x TXT Loader MultiConcat node to have the path where you want to save the .txt files.

#6: When ready, click Extra options, put in a value from 1-2048 into the Batch Count, then click Queue Prompt. Sit back and watch it go. (I do recommend testing with a small number before running a large batch, just to make sure everything's setup ok.)

Thank you for checking out the workflow and I hope it's useful to you. -soul
